a: Nextube is a neon-style liquid sorting puzzle for Android. Organize coloured liquid in tubes and solve levels by planning your moves.
Tap one tube, then tap another to pour. A pour is allowed only when the top colour matches and the destination has space. The goal is one colour per tube.

q: Can I pour any colour into any tube?
a: No. The top colour must match the colour at the top of the destination tube, and the destination must have enough free space.

q: Can I undo or restart a puzzle?
a: Yes. The game provides Undo and Reset controls so you can reconsider a move or restart the current board.
